description: This file defines session reset policies, types, and utility functions for handling session resets, including determining reset types, scheduling resets, and evaluating session freshness.

methods.name: isThreadSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if the given session key corresponds to a thread session by resolving thread info.

methods.name: resolveSessionResetType
methods.description: Determines the reset type ('direct', 'group', or 'thread') based on session parameters.

methods.name: resolveThreadFlag
methods.description: Determines if the session or message indicates a thread based on various parameters.

methods.name: resolveDailyResetAtMs
methods.description: Calculates the timestamp for the daily reset at a specific hour.

methods.name: resolveSessionResetPolicy
methods.description: Generates the session reset policy based on configuration, reset type, and overrides.

methods.name: resolveChannelResetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves reset configuration for a specific channel.

methods.name: evaluateSessionFreshness
methods.description: Evaluates whether a session is fresh based on last update time and reset policies.
